太宰 is the Grand Steward.
Daogui further put Huaisu in charge of the nine Jiangxia commanderies and gave him acting authority at Xiaokou.
Daogui further put Huaisu in charge of the nine Jiangxia commanderies and gave him acting authority at Xiakou.
In the eighteenth year the Di chieftain Yang Dandang invaded Hanzhong; Zhendao led an army against him and defeated him.
In the eighteenth year the Di chieftain Yang Nandang invaded Hanzhong; Zhendao led an army against him and defeated him.
But Dandang's raids continued; Emperor Wen sent Longxiang General Pei Fangming with five thousand palace troops under Zhendao's command.
But Nandang's raids continued; Emperor Wen sent Longxiang General Pei Fangming with five thousand palace troops under Zhendao's command.

Dandang sent his general who establishes the staff Fu Hongzu and Tan Yuan to hold Langao, his general who pacifies the north Fu Deyi to serve as a mobile force outside, and his son He, general-in-chief who pacifies the army, to follow with a large rear guard.

Nandang sent his general who establishes the staff Fu Hongzu and Tan Yuan to hold Langao, his general who pacifies the north Fu Deyi to serve as a mobile force outside, and his son He, general-in-chief who pacifies the army, to follow with a large rear guard.
Dandang sent general who establishes loyalty Yang Lin and general who shakes might Yao Xian with two thousand horsemen to join He; Fangming led the generals against them again.
Nandang sent general who establishes loyalty Yang Lin and general who shakes might Yao Xian with two thousand horsemen to join He; Fangming led the generals against them again.
He was defeated and fled; the pursuit reached Chiting; Dandang gathered what he could and fled in disorder.
He was defeated and fled; the pursuit reached Chiting; Nandang gathered what he could and fled in disorder.
Dandang's third son Hu had garrisoned Yinping; when Dandang fled, Hu hid among the people, was taken alive, sent to the capital, and executed in the Jiankang market.
Nandang's third son Hu had garrisoned Yinping; when Nandang fled, Hu hid among the people, was taken alive, sent to the capital, and executed in the Jiankang market.
An edict said, "In former years the Di rebel Yang Dandang rose in rebellion; many submitted.
An edict said, "In former years the Di rebel Yang Nandang rose in rebellion; many submitted.
Zhendao and Fangming were both convicted for embezzling gold, silver, and other spoils from the conquest of Chouci and for hiding Dandang's fine horses; they were imprisoned and died.
Zhendao and Fangming were both convicted for embezzling gold, silver, and other spoils from the conquest of Chouchi and for hiding Nandang's fine horses; they were imprisoned and died.
難當 is read Nandang. 仇池 is Chouchi.

In the nineteenth year Fangming reached Wuxing and advanced with Heir Apparent's general of repeated crossbows Liu Kangzu, rear army staff officer Liang Tan, Chen Mi, Pei Suzhi, Anxi staff officer Duan Shuwen, Lu Shangqi, regular attendant of the Principality of Shixing Liu Sengxiu, general who pacifies the distance Ma Xi, Zhenwu general Wang Huazhi, and others to Tangu, a few li from Gaolan.

In the nineteenth year Fangming reached Wuxing and advanced with Heir Apparent's general of repeated crossbows Liu Kangzu, rear army staff officer Liang Tan, Chen Mi, Pei Suzhi, Anxi staff officer Duan Shuwen, Lu Shangqi, regular attendant of the Principality of Shixing Liu Sengxiu, general who pacifies the distance Ma Xi, Zhenwu general Wang Huanzhi, and others to Tangu, a few li from Gaolan.
Fuzhao of Lueyang was sincerely loyal to the dynasty and joined the effort; he captured a rebel general, took Wuxing alone, led the vanguard to victory, and fell to the enemy.
Fu Zhao of Lueyang was sincerely loyal to the dynasty and joined the effort; he captured a rebel general, took Wuxing alone, led the vanguard to victory, and fell to the enemy.
Wanshou shall be posthumously made Longxiang general and administrator of Zhaowu commandery;
Wanshou shall be posthumously made Longxiang general and and Zhao administrator of Wudu;
昭 is Fu Zhao; 武都 is the commandery.
Tan shall be made major on the staff of the general-in-chief who conquers the west and administrator of Chouci; all should be relocated inland.
Tan shall be made major on the staff of the general-in-chief who conquers the west and administrator of Chouchi; all should be relocated inland.

Another edict said, "The late Jinshou administrator Jiang Daosheng, in the campaign against Chouci, gave his loyalty and strength; in battle he distinguished himself and remained incorruptible before wealth.

Another edict said, "The late Jinshou administrator Jiang Daosheng, in the campaign against Chouchi, gave his loyalty and strength; in battle he distinguished himself and remained incorruptible before wealth.
Fangming sent Kangzu straight to Baiyu; the rebel chancellor Yang Wanshou and others surrendered at once.
Fangming sent Kangzu straight to Baiqing; the rebel chancellor Yang Wanshou and others surrendered at once.
Qinzhou inspector Hu Chongzhi marched west to garrison Baiyu; at Zhuoshui he was ambushed by the northern barbarians, defeated, and killed.
Qinzhou inspector Hu Chongzhi marched west to garrison Baiqing; at Zhuoshui he was ambushed by the northern barbarians, defeated, and killed.
Emperor Wu's father Heng had been Jin administrator of Henan.
His great-great-grandfather Heng had been Jin administrator of Henan.
高祖 here is Meng Huaiyu's great-great-grandfather, not Emperor Wu.

His father Chuo, after the founding uprising, became palace attendant and grand master for splendid happiness, and was posthumously made grand master for the palace with golden seal and purple ribbon.
His father Chuo, after the founding uprising, became palace attendant and superintendent of the palace, and was posthumously made grand master for the palace with golden seal and purple ribbon.
光祿勳 is the Superintendent of the Palace.
Huixi's son Zong succeeded him and served as administrator of Jingling and palace attendant.
Huixi's son Zong succeeded him and served as administrator of Jingling and palace grand master.
中大夫 is Palace Grand Master.
During Emperor Wen's Yuankai reign, Weisheng was stripped of his title for a crime and exiled to Guangzhou; Fohu, son of Weisheng's brother Yanzu, inherited the title.
During Emperor Wen's Yuanjia reign, Weisheng was stripped of his title for a crime and exiled to Guangzhou; Fohu, son of Weisheng's brother Yanzu, inherited the title.
He entered official life as staff officer on Wang Gong's vanguard command and later joined the staff of Yuan Xian, heir of Kuaiji, on his campaign staff.
He entered official life as staff officer on Wang Gong's vanguard command and later joined the staff of Sima Yuanxian, heir of Kuaiji, on his campaign staff.
Yuan Xian was promoted to rear general; Jingxuan was made staff adviser and further promoted to ningshuo general.
Sima Yuanxian was promoted to rear general; Jingxuan was made staff adviser and further promoted to ningshuo general.
In Long'an 3, Wang Gong raised an army at Jingkou on the pretext of punishing the brothers Sima Shangzhi.
In Long'an 3, Wang Gong raised an army at Jingkou on the pretext of punishing Sima Shangzhi and his brothers.
司馬尚之兄弟 is Shangzhi and his brothers.
This is not a trap set at Xiapi."

下邳 refers to Liu Yu (former Administrator of Xiapi).
He sent Jingxuan as his envoy, and Xuan appointed him staff adviser on his staff.
He sent Jingxuan as a hostage, and Xuan appointed him staff adviser on his staff.

While holding Jiangling he learned Jingxuan had come back and sent word to Liu Yu: "The Jingxuans' loyalty to the throne has always been doubtful, and they did not join us when the righteous cause began.

While holding Jiangling he learned Jingxuan had come back and sent word to Liu Yu: "Liu Jingxuan and his father's loyalty to the throne has always been doubtful, and they did not join us when the righteous cause began.
劉敬宣父子 is Jingxuan and his father.
Qiao Zong floated downriver the coffins of Mao Qiong's entire household, his wife and daughters, Wen Chumao's mother Lady He, and several gentry — Jingxuan recovered every coffin and sent them home.
Qiao Zong floated downriver the coffins of Mao Qu's entire household, his wife and daughters, Wen Chumao's mother Lady He, and several gentry — Jingxuan recovered every coffin and sent them home.

While Liu Yu marched west against Liu Yi, Inspector of Yuzhou Zhuge Changmin, acting grand marshal, wrote to Jingxuan: "Panlong's brutal arrogance destroyed him; the last rebels are nearly gone and the age is settling into peace — let us share the rewards together."

While Liu Yu marched west against Liu Yi, Inspector of Yuzhou Zhuge Changmin, supervising the Grand Marshal's military affairs, wrote to Jingxuan: "Panlong's brutal arrogance destroyed him; the last rebels are nearly gone and the age is settling into peace — let us share the rewards together."
監太尉軍事 is a supervisory post, not acting grand marshal.
Sima Daoci was a minor, low-ranking branch of the Jin imperial house.
Sima Daoci was a lowly distant member of the Jin imperial house.
賤屬 refers to a lowly kinsman.
